DISCUSS: Who are these guys? Trautwein's troops in the trenches are difference makers
The guys up front helped Jadan Baugh score another TD against Ole Miss (Photo by Chris Spears) “Who are these guys?” – Paul Newman as Butch Cassidy in the classic film “Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid” We could be asking the same question of the Florida offensive line. In their preseason analysis, the fine folks at Athlon and Phil Steele ranked Florida’s…
